findings.candidate_classification: The legacy count of 32 combines 31 UNSUPPORTED_ASSEMBLY candidates and one LOW_SUPPORT_ASSEMBLY candidate. Thirty 56-nt unsupported candidates are exact target substrings, ten unique sequence hashes repeated once in each development/tuning/held-out run. The remaining 62-nt unsupported and 111-nt low-support candidates have local truth identity near 0.72 and no/one qualifying support row respectively. These are repetitive partial contigs, not complete reconstructions.
findings.reference_screening: No target-read loss is demonstrated in the two failed M6 cases: the M6 stage failed SAM identity validation before emitting residual FASTQ; the compact report encoded missing output as zero coverage.
findings.sam_validation: The failed SAM records are supplementary alignments with hard-clipped sequence fields. The validator compares each SAM SEQ field to the full input read, so this is an M6 SAM-validation incompatibility, not evidence that reference screening removed the target reads.
